description: This file contains utility functions for managing control states in a React-based visualization configuration, including validation, handling missing choices, applying state mappings, and aggregating control states.

methods.name: execControlValidator
methods.description: Executes validators for a control and updates its validation errors.

methods.name: handleMissingChoice
methods.description: Clears control values that are no longer in the choices list.

methods.name: applyMapStateToPropsToControl
methods.description: Applies mapStateToProps to control state and validates it.

methods.name: getControlStateFromControlConfig
methods.description: Generates control state from control configuration and panel state.

methods.name: getControlState
methods.description: Retrieves control state based on control key, viz type, panel state, and value.

methods.name: getAllControlsState
methods.description: Aggregates all control states for a given visualization type and datasource.
